scripts.setup: npm exec --yes --package @yarnpkg/cli-dist@4.12.0 -- yarn install --immutable && npm exec --yes --package @yarnpkg/cli-dist@4.12.0 -- yarn --cwd server install --immutable && npm exec --yes --package @yarnpkg/cli-dist@4.12.0 -- yarn --cwd client install --immutable
scripts.start: bash scripts/stop-game.sh && yarn --cwd server ensure-cache && yarn concurrently --names server,client "yarn --cwd server dev:panel" "yarn --cwd client start"
scripts.start:prod: yarn --cwd server ensure-cache && yarn concurrently --names server,client "yarn --cwd server start:prod" "yarn --cwd client serve"
